description: This Java class defines an Hibernate interceptor called ImmutableObsInterceptor within the OpenMRS project. Its purpose is to enforce immutability on 'Obs' (Observation) entities by intercepting edits, voids, and replacements, except for certain mutable properties and when the object is voided.

classes.name: ImmutableObsInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor that enforces immutability of 'Obs' entities by intercepting modifications, voids, and replacements, with configurable mutable properties.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Returns the class type this interceptor supports, which is 'Obs'.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Returns the list of property names that are mutable and can be changed after object creation.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Indicates whether voided or retired objects should be ignored by this interceptor, returning true.
